newsitem.title: CHINA: General Re opens first China office.
newsitem.headline: General Re opens first China office.

text.p: U.S.-based General Re Corp has opened its first China representative office in Shanghai, a company official said on Friday.
The company is to set up an insurance training and information centre in Shanghai, he said.

Since 1994, the General Re has provided 10 senior Shanghai insurance officials with scholarships for training course in the United States and has sponsored four insurance seminars in Shanghai and Beijing, he said.
The official declined to say when or if the company will be allowed to sell reinsurance in China.
In September, the Swiss Reinsurance Co opened the first foreign reinsurance representative office in China.
In July, China set up its first reinsurance company, the People's Reinsurance Company of China Ltd.
Dozens of foreign insurance firms, keen to tap China's potentially huge insurance market, have set up representative offices in China.

But only two, American International Assurance Co Ltd, a member of American International Group and Tokio Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd, have been given permission to sell policies in China on their own.
